text: This is Steamboat Geyser, the tallest active geyser in the world.
Its big eruptions shoot more than 300 feet.
It had been mostly quiet for decades.
It came back to life after that earthquake.
Then in 2018, it woke up again and erupted 48 times in 2019, a record.
Last year, in 2025, it erupted just three times.
When we stood here, it was only steaming.
The park calls it entirely unpredictable.
